subject: Trading
title: Majors, Minors, and Exotics
description: A quick win: understand Majors, Minors, and Exotics.

hook.text: Not all currency pairs are equal. EUR/USD trades more in one hour than some exotic pairs trade in a year.

buildup.text: Majors pair the US dollar with big economies: EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, NZD. They're the most liquid.

discovery.text: Minors skip the dollar: EUR/GBP, EUR/JPY, GBP/AUD. Less liquid but still actively traded.

twist.text: Exotics pair a major with a small economy: USD/TRY, EUR/ZAR. Wide spreads, wild moves, and thin liquidity.

climax.text: Liquidity determines cost. Majors give tight spreads. Exotics charge you just to enter the trade.

punchline.text: Liquidity is the invisible cost of every trade.

quiz.question: Why are exotic currency pairs more expensive to trade?
options: Low liquidity means wider bid-ask spreads
